processDescription: 5-axis CNC milling centers provide simultaneous multi-axis interpolation for complex titanium components. The ability to tilt the tool relative to the workpiece surface maintains optimal chip load and extends tool life, critical for difficult-to-machine titanium alloys, specifically for watch case. Precision watch case for Watchmaking present unique challenges: Cosmetic surface finish (mirror polish, brush, or bead blast) with sub-mm feature detail. Material traceability from mill to finished case.
heatControl: Minimal heat generation due to fine finishing passes. Air blast for chip clearing sufficient; coolant not required for cosmetic finishing passes.
flatnessControl: Stress-relieved raw material and sequenced roughing/finishing passes. Heat-sink fixturing for thin-wall sections minimizes thermal distortion.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for CNC milling + diamond-cut beveling of watch bezels, utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
